maintenance_led.reason: Sells distilled spirits, branded whiskey and food ingredients as new products; consumables, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are beverage brands, food manufacturers and consumers buying spirits; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own distilling and ingredient sales; acquisitions like Luxco and Penelope were occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Mostly bulk and branded spirits and wheat protein or starch ingredients; customers can generally switch suppliers, though aged-whiskey contracts add some friction.

notes: Switching difficulty for ingredient customers and aged whiskey supply contracts is somewhat uncertain.
